name: Dependency-Preserving Question Decomposition
mechanism: Splits a composite or multi-hop request into bounded subquestions with explicit dependencies and separately traceable retrieval results.
use_when: Answering requires evidence from multiple entities pages or hops
A single query consistently misses an identifiable evidence dependency
avoid_when: Direct lookup dominates and decomposition adds no coverage
The task constraints cannot be reliably propagated to every subquestion
expected_effects: Higher hop-level and final evidence coverage
Auditable mapping from subquestion to evidence
failure_modes: Incorrect decomposition makes the original question unsolvable
Global constraints or negation disappear from a subquestion
Duplicate or cyclic work expands cost
required_evals: tool calls latency and stop behavior
